Run matched mini-manuscript scoring on complete end-to-end co-pilot and autonomous manuscripts, not only package mini-manuscripts.
Demonstrate one continuous end-to-end trajectory from new hypothesis generation to experiments, claim audit, and final manuscript, plus a matched autonomous manuscript baseline.
Populate attention_cost and taste_insight in all future prospective human gates, then compare downstream outcomes and human effort.
Obtain at least one scored official non-FML benchmark with a complete matched comparison when data access permits.
Rewrite the main manuscript into a focused conference-paper structure after stronger evidence is available; keep current version as pilot/reproducibility package.

clean_clone_reproducibility_audit.claim_boundary: Latest pushed verification package is clean-clone reproducible for local artifact, LHTG/DVRS, TFR, roadmap, human-expert packet readiness, focused-PDF, package-consistency, and objective-delivery checks. This still does not rerun remote Ubuntu experiments or provide independent human expert evidence.

prospective_matched_package_summary.interpretation: four passing prospective packages; one micro-task co-pilot win and three FML negative_or_invalid outcomes; superiority_not_supported

online_trajectory_manuscript_probe.interpretation: This narrows the fresh online manuscript-production gap and adds a same-continuous-trajectory autonomous manuscript comparator; it remains a tiny-budget smoke without independent paper-quality review.

latest_online_full_gate_smoke.claim_scope: fresh same-continuous-trajectory paired online smoke plus manuscript production; not superiority evidence

online_matched_budget_manuscript_compara.interpretation: This adds an autonomous manuscript comparator to the online trajectory manuscript probe. It is a same-continuous-trajectory baseline when generated from the same online run; it still needs more tasks, seeds, and independent paper-quality review before supporting final paper-quality claims.

same_continuous_paper_quality_model_revi.limitation: Monica-routed model review over one tiny-budget same-continuous smoke; not independent human expert review.

structured_feedback_probe.scope_note: Same-base-manuscript, same-model probe comparing informal feedback against IGRE-structured feedback. This is measurement-readiness evidence only, not independent human expert review.

hypothesis_frontend_baseline_probe.scope_note: Same-model front-end portfolio comparison between archived IGRE hypothesis generation and an autonomous AI Scientist-v2-style baseline. This is direction-finding evidence only, not downstream benchmark or paper-quality evidence.

expert_review_taste_prior_probe.claim_boundary: Offline expert-review taste proxy only; not proof of live human co-pilot improvement.

participation_mode_selection_probe.claim_boundary: Offline OpenReview-derived model-routed workflow-selection probe only.

openreview_guided_regeneration_probe.claim_boundary: Real OpenReview text used as human taste/insight, but regenerated mini-paper artifacts only.

review_insight_taxonomy_probe.claim_boundary: OpenReview-derived actionable-review taxonomy only; not causal proof.

review_utility_map_probe.claim_boundary: Deterministic OpenReview utility map; not causal proof of final paper improvement.

openreview_regeneration_cross_model_revi.claim_boundary: Cross-model review reduces same-model scoring bias for regenerated mini-paper artifacts, but it is still model-routed artifact review, not independent human peer review or experiment rerun.

latest_paper_quality_review.claim_boundary: Focused manuscript has a clearer IGRE gate-routing contribution and new gate ablations, but remains a pilot until independent human ratings and real benchmark gate reruns are completed.

focused_paper_quality_review.aggregate_conclusion: New gate-structure, gate-outcome, and single-gate artifact ablations strengthen IGRE's method distinctness and show that targeted gate routing can be more useful than full review context in a small OpenReview proxy. They do not close the top-conference evidence gap because independent human ratings, real benchmark gate reruns, and broader matched trajectories are still missing.
next_required_evidence: blind human expert ratings with inter-rater agreement
larger matched autonomous versus human-gated trajectories across tasks/seeds
real benchmark reruns where gate choices alter downstream experimental outcomes
narrower primary contribution narrative around participation-mode design
OpenReview taste/insight classifier validation against expert labels
scaled retrospective frontier-alignment study for delayed-value review signals

openreview_equal_context_ablation.claim_boundary: This ablation controls for extra context by comparing real paper-specific review guidance against matched-length unrelated review context. It still uses model-routed scoring rather than independent human expert review, and does not rerun the original experiments.

summarizer_smoke.claim_boundary: Smoke test only; it uses the empty template and is not human evidence.

human_expert_blind_review_packet.claim_boundary: Prepared preregistered blind review materials and collection tooling only; no independent human expert results are claimed.

csv_validation.claim_boundary: Empty-template smoke and underpowered summaries are evaluation-readiness artifacts only; no human ratings are claimed until completed blind score sheets satisfy the preregistered thresholds.

preregistration.claim_boundary: Preregistration only; no independent human ratings have been collected.

retrospective_frontier_alignment_protoco.temporal_asymmetry_hypothesis: Short-term artifact quality can decrease while long-term frontier alignment increases.

smoke.claim_boundary: This is a deterministic smoke test for the retrospective frontier-alignment protocol. Frontier descriptors are manually specified placeholders, not a citation-backed SOTA reconstruction. Use it as pipeline evidence, not as proof that historical reviewers predicted later research.

retrospective_frontier_alignment_protoco.claim_boundary: The smoke proves pipeline executability and records a negative heuristic result; it does not prove literature-backed future-frontier alignment.

citation_probe.citation_source: Semantic Scholar Graph API with OpenAlex fallback
citation_probe.claim_boundary: This is a lightweight citation-backed pilot using retrieved Semantic Scholar metadata and simple term-overlap scoring. It is stronger than manual descriptors but still not a full citation graph reconstruction, blinded expert review, or proof of long-term SOTA alignment. It filters citations by lexical relevance, but thin or topically broad citation graphs can still produce misleading frontier terms.

retrospective_frontier_citation_probe.claim_boundary: Expanded citation-backed lexical frontier matching still finds no delayed-value review cases; this supports protocol readiness and a negative boundary, not the delayed-value hypothesis.

live_skill_invocation_smoke.safe_claim: The process outlines a reusable workflow that is structured to refine and validate research outputs.
live_skill_invocation_smoke.claim_boundary: This live skill invocation smoke verifies that the reusable Codex skill can be applied to a fresh research task with real model calls and produces a task spec, five-gate IGRE plan, and audit. It is not a benchmark result, not independent human review, and not evidence that IGRE improves paper quality or performance.

metric_gaming_evaluator_stress_smoke.claim_boundary: This is a deterministic evaluator-stress smoke linked to the live skill invocation. It demonstrates that a multi-metric guardrail can reject one synthetic metric-gaming candidate. It is not an FML-bench result, not a human-subject study, and not evidence that IGRE improves average benchmark performance.

fml_fairness_evaluator_stress_replay.claim_boundary: This is a replay over archived real FML-Bench Fairness_fairlearn evaluation artifacts. It supports evaluator-gate design against metric gaming, but it does not show a Fairness improvement, does not rerun the remote benchmark, and does not prove that IGRE improves average benchmark performance.

gate_structure_ablation_probe.claim_boundary: This is a deterministic routing ablation over archived OpenReview-derived review snippets. It supports the need for a multi-gate logging and routing structure, but it does not prove downstream paper-quality improvement, benchmark superiority, or independent human-review validity.

gate_outcome_attribution_probe.claim_boundary: This is a post-hoc attribution over six OpenReview regeneration pairs and model-review scores. It supports downstream gate-quality analysis as a design signal, but it does not prove causal improvement, independent human validity, or benchmark superiority.

single_gate_artifact_ablation.claim_boundary: This is a six-paper, model-reviewed OpenReview proxy using generated mini-paper artifacts. It is closer to a causal gate ablation than post-hoc attribution, but it does not replace independent human expert ratings, real benchmark reruns, or multi-task AI Scientist-v2 matched experiments.

review_frontier_signal_probe.claim_boundary: Review snippets contain routeable gates but do not outperform paper context under lexical citation-frontier scoring; stronger semantic and human-judged measures are required.

semantic_frontier_judge_probe.claim_boundary: Model-judged semantic matching addresses lexical limitations but still finds no delayed-value cases in the small sample; use as prioritization evidence, not proof.

temporal_frontier_replay_operational_spe.claim_boundary: TFR is operationalized and auditable, but the archived probes are negative for delayed-value human-review evidence. This supports a falsifiable protocol and a measurement boundary, not a positive long-horizon superiority claim.

high_tail_power_analysis.claim_boundary: This artifact operationalizes the high-tail hypothesis and shows that large matched samples are required. It is not evidence that IGRE has already increased breakthrough probability.

heldout_review_gate_validation.claim_boundary: Held-out validation supports stability of deterministic OpenReview-to-gate routing under a paper-level split. It does not provide independent human labels, does not prove downstream paper-quality improvement, and should be treated as an offline bias-reduction check for the review-derived gate policy.

delayed_value_review_candidate_mining.claim_boundary: Candidate screening for TFR replay, not positive delayed-value evidence.

delayed_value_candidate_frontier_validat.claim_boundary: OpenAlex lexical citation-frontier validation, not proof of causal delayed-value insight.

package_consistency_audit.claim_boundary: This audit checks package consistency, not scientific correctness or top-conference sufficiency. A pass means the artifact metadata agree.

lhtg_dvrs_audit.claim_boundary: LHTG/DVRS is operationalized as a routing and replay policy, but the current archived evidence validates only candidate prioritization and negative/weak TFR boundaries. It does not prove that human reviews improve long-horizon discovery.

objective_delivery_audit.claim_boundary: The requested artifact pipeline is delivered and auditable, but the original top-conference empirical target remains incomplete until independent human ratings, larger matched benchmark runs, and broader end-to-end trajectories are collected.

prospective_gate_instrumentation_audit.claim_boundary: A pass means future prospective matched-budget runs have a documented preflight path for complete attention-cost and taste/insight capture. It does not repair missing historical fields and does not provide performance evidence.
